body_text: We see every child’s journey as a triangle of Child, Parent and Teacher. Our vision is for Ananya Tots to feel like a second home.
title: Parenting Workshops
text: Regular sessions to help you understand and respond to your child’s needs.
text_2: Guidance from child-development professionals on growth, dental care and speech and language.

image.alt: Educator kneeling to talk with a young girl and her mother

text_3: You are invited to fairs, celebrations, special events and learning experiences.
text_4: Teachers and parents share observations and celebrate progress together.
